name: search-messages
description: Searches Gmail messages using Gmail search syntax and returns metadata, snippets, labels, and unread status. Message ids feed gmail__get-message; threadIds feed gmail__get-thread and gmail__reply-to-thread.

query.description: Gmail search syntax, as used in the Gmail search box (for example, from:someone is:unread).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching messages to return.
